title: Current availability and how to book
body: I train weekdays 7-8am and 4:30-6:30pm, Fridays and Saturdays 7am-6:30pm, and Sundays 2-4pm. Free video/phone consults are available too. New clients start with an In-Home Consult ($30 deposit, paid at the consult and credited toward training). In El Paso County, book a time online from the Book a Session page. Outside El Paso County, email training@k9-communication.com so I can plan drive time; a mileage fee applies.
